newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telesp price target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telesp price target raised.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns said in a report it had raised its year-end price target on Brazilian telecom company Telesp to $335, representing a 25 percent upside potential from current levels.
-- It said the company should benefit from a tariff restructuring announced late Thursday. An increase in local tariffs should offset a decrease in long-distance revenues, it said.
-- Bear Stearns raised its 1997 earnings estimate for Telesp to $18.55 a share from $16.70, and raised its 1998 estimate to $26.50 from $22.25.

-- "Telesp should be one of the first of Telebras's local operating companies to be privatized .... we believe with new higher tariffs and further improvement in efficiency, the company's valuation should be further enhanced," it said.
-- Telesp preferred shares traded at 305 reais, up 5.54 percent.
-- The real closed at 1.0577 to the dollar Thursday.
